
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Subtracts a scalar constant from each element in an input one-dimensional
    single-precision floating-point ndarray and assigns the results to elements
    in a one-dimensional single-precision floating-point output ndarray.

    The output ndarray is modified *in-place* (i.e., the output ndarray is
    *mutated*).

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

        - a one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - a one-dimensional output ndarray.
        - a zero-dimensional ndarray containing the scalar constant to subtract.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = [ -2.0, 1.0, 3.0, -5.0 ];
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/float32}}( xbuf );
    > var w = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/float32}}( 4 );
    > var opts = { 'dtype': 'float32' };
    > var alpha = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/from-scalar}}( 5.0, opts );
    > {{alias}}( [ x, w, alpha ] )
    <ndarray>[ -7.0, -4.0, -2.0, -10.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
